home.heroSubtitle: Book wonderful villas in the most beautiful places in the world

footer.about: A platform for booking the most beautiful villas in the heart of nature. Every place gives you an unforgettable experience.
footer.faqBookingA: Choose the villa you like, select your dates and press the "Book" button.
footer.faqPaymentA: You can pay securely by bank card.
footer.cancelPolicyText: If you cancel at least 48 hours before the booked date, 100% of the payment is refunded. Cancellations after that are not refunded.
footer.privacyText: Your personal data is used only to process your booking and is not shared with third parties. Data is stored on Supabase servers, passwords are kept encrypted (hashed), and each user can only see their own bookings and favorites.

about.heroSubtitle: Wild Haven — unique villas in the most beautiful corners of the world
about.story1: Wild Haven was born in 2020 from a simple idea — to help people find places far from the noise of the city, face to face with nature. We choose every villa by hand and personally check its views, comfort and atmosphere.
about.story2: Today we have given more than a thousand guests an unforgettable holiday — from houses in the foothills to luxurious lakeside villas.

1.name: Lakeside Villa
1.description: A luxurious villa on the shore of Lake Lugano. A private path down to the water, a spacious terrace and mountain views await you.

2.name: Mountain Retreat
2.description: A cozy house at the foot of the mountains near Lake Como. A fireplace, wooden interior and a quiet courtyard make it ideal for a family holiday.

3.name: Modern Villa
3.description: A modern seaside villa in Marbella. An infinity pool, a spacious living room and a sunny terrace.

4.name: Quiet Haven
4.description: A peaceful house among the fields of Provence. A lavender-scented garden, an open kitchen and calm mornings await you.

5.name: White Coast Villa
5.description: A villa in the style of Santorini's famous white houses. A spacious terrace, sunset views and a quiet courtyard await you.

6.name: Tropical Paradise
6.description: A villa with a private pool among the palms on the island of Bali. A tropical garden, calm mornings and a spot close to the sea.

7.name: Jeju Island House
7.description: A modern house with wooden accents on Jeju Island. Close to the sea, with a quiet courtyard and a convenient location.

8.name: Chimyon Mountain House
8.description: A wooden house in the Chimyon mountains. Fresh air, forest views, a fireplace and a spacious yard for a family holiday.
